versions.subject: Add setvalue for Details
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\TelemetryController\'
    Details|endswith: 
        - .sh
        - .exe
        - .dll
        - .bin
        - .bat
        - .cmd
        - .js
        - .ps
        - .vb
        - .jar
        - .hta
        - .msi
        - .vbs
condition: selection
